content: Qt vertical CJK: no writing-mode vertical-rl in Qt rich text (forum.qt.io/topic/105181). Two real paths: (1) custom QAbstractTextDocumentLayout subclass installed via QTextDocument.setDocumentLayout - the production open-source path taken by BallonsTranslator (GPL-3.0, PyQt6): its VerticalTextDocumentLayout lays one QTextLine per column with setNumColumns(1) + WrapAnywhere, columns flow RTL by decrementing x, rotates Latin/punct runs per-line via QTransform(0,1,0,-1,...) in draw(), centers upright punctuation via rasterized alpha bbox (punc_actual_rect), supports effect padding + hitTest + cursor; (2) per-char/run custom paint in a QGraphicsItem - render-only, no edit machinery. Qt 6.11 QAbstractTextDocumentLayout API verified from doc.qt.io: 6 pure virtuals (documentChanged, draw, documentSize, blockBoundingRect, frameBoundingRect, hitTest, pageCount). For render-only vertical (D-12 excludes vertical editing), per-char/run painting is the least-surprising path; document-layout is justified only when editing/hit-test/IME is needed.
